newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on institutional support.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended up in retail buying in a market supported by institutional investors, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 27.11 points or 1.77 percent to 1,554.61 on a turnover of 133.9 million taka. Of the 109 issues traded 71 closed higher, 33 ended down and five were unchanged.
Chittagong Cement Klinker gained 143 taka to 3,844, Aziz Pipes rose 34.84 to 1,632.14, Shine Pukur Holdings lost 3.20 to 115.12.
Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
